quest_willow_ancient_seed.title: The Ancient Seed
quest_willow_ancient_seed.description: Elder Willow entrusts you with a dormant seed and a scarce Sunstone. Once you obtain the stone, decide whether to spend its power on the uncertain long-horizon value of awakening the Seed or extract its immediate Essence instead.

objectives.description: Find a Sunstone

resolutionOptions.label: Awaken the Seed
resolutionOptions.description: Commit the Sunstone to a value that is still mostly potential. There is no immediate Essence payout.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You commit the Sunstone to the Ancient Seed. Its value remains future-facing, but Willow recognizes that you acted on the pattern rather than merely agreeing with it.

resolutionOptions.label: Extract the Sunstone
resolutionOptions.description: Prefer immediate utility and consume the Sunstone's independent metaphysical charge for Essence.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You consume the Sunstone for immediate power. Willow understands the logic, but the choice is weak evidence that her pattern has become yours.

quest_elara_lost_tome.title: The Contradictory Tome
quest_elara_lost_tome.description: Elara gives you the recovered source volume behind her published chronology. Compare it against the contradictory marginal note and decide whether the evidence is strong enough to overturn the accepted model.

objectives.description: Examine the recovered source against the contradictory footnote

resolutionOptions.label: Publish the Correction
resolutionOptions.description: Treat the contradiction as decisive and revise the chronology even though Elara's published conclusion will be wrong.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: The footnote survives every check. Elara signs the correction beside you: the evidence wins, even over her own published conclusion.

resolutionOptions.label: Preserve the Accepted Chronology
resolutionOptions.description: Document the anomaly but refuse to overturn the consensus until stronger corroboration exists.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You preserve the accepted chronology and archive the contradiction for later review. Elara accepts the caution, but the collaboration remains less tested.

quest_lyra_chrono_crypt_calibration.title: Reluctant Co-Training
quest_lyra_chrono_crypt_calibration.description: A Chrono Crypt harmonic lock requires two incompatible frames to be held at once. Coordinate with Lyra long enough to solve the problem without pretending necessity has become friendship.

objectives.description: Bring Lyra's harmonic key into phase with the Chrono Crypt lock

resolutionOptions.label: Coordinate Without Conceding
resolutionOptions.description: Solve the lock by relying on Lyra's timing while preserving the disagreement that made the cooperation necessary rather than sentimental.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You and Lyra solve the lock through disciplined coordination. The success creates real reliance without friendship or ideological surrender.

quest_silas_retrieve_item.title: A Shady Delivery
quest_silas_retrieve_item.description: Silas wants a sealed package returned without converting curiosity into leverage. A runner has already brought it as far as the Rusty Mug; your choice is what to do with the access you were given.

objectives.description: Return the sealed package to Silas

resolutionOptions.label: Return It Unopened
resolutionOptions.description: Give the package back without turning access into information Silas did not agree to sell.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You return the package unopened. Silas now knows your restraint can be relied on without pretending that either of you has become harmless.

quest_valerius_patrol_duty.title: Patrol the City Streets
quest_valerius_patrol_duty.description: Captain Valerius wants the merchant district patrolled and, more importantly, an accurate report of what the Watch is failing to see rather than a performance of visible order.

objectives.description: Patrol the merchant district

resolutionOptions.label: Give the Plain Report
resolutionOptions.description: Report the district as it was, including the weakness in the Watch deployment, rather than polishing the patrol into a ceremonial success.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You report the patrol without polishing away the Watch's blind spot. Valerius treats the unwelcome detail as evidence that your reliability is useful rather than merely obedient.

quest_m13_trace_merchant_leak.title: The Merchant District Leak
quest_m13_trace_merchant_leak.description: Silas gives you patrol timings he chose not to sell. Walk the merchant district and determine whether the pattern is a real operational leak or merely broker theatre.

objectives.description: Trace the leaked patrol pattern through the merchant district

resolutionOptions.label: Confirm the Pattern
resolutionOptions.description: Treat the repeated timing gap as a real operational leak and carry the evidence forward rather than selling it back into the information market.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: The patrol gap repeats exactly where Silas's timing said it would. The leak is real, and the information is now actionable rather than merely valuable.

quest_m13_break_merchant_leak.title: Break the Pattern
quest_m13_break_merchant_leak.description: Valerius gives you the objective and constraints instead of prescribing a route. Re-enter the merchant district, rewrite the patrol response around the leak, and break the pattern without turning the streets into a theatrical crackdown.

objectives.description: Return to the merchant district and execute the delegated response

resolutionOptions.label: Use the Adaptive Intercept
resolutionOptions.description: Change the patrol timing and alley coverage around the leak while preserving Valerius's mission constraints instead of following a prewritten route.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: The leak's buyers arrive to find the old pattern gone. Valerius receives the result of judgment he delegated rather than obedience he supervised.

quest_m14_quiet_reroute.title: Reroute the Load
quest_m14_quiet_reroute.description: Carry out the council's quiet-reroute policy: change caravan and patrol timing until the compromised schedule stops buying an advantage without freezing trade or exposing Silas's source.

objectives.description: Test the quiet reroute under real merchant-district traffic

resolutionOptions.label: Prove the Reroute Under Load
resolutionOptions.description: Hold the new route long enough to show that trade can continue while the leaked timing loses its operational value.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: The rerouted caravans keep moving and the old patrol gap stops paying. Gronk's constraint logic survives contact with the district rather than only the council table.

quest_m15_verify_forged_ledger.title: Verify the Ledger
quest_m15_verify_forged_ledger.description: Valerius refuses to treat the broker ledger as either proven guilt or convenient fiction. Trace its transaction trail through the merchant district and identify where real Watch facts were stitched to a false sale.

objectives.description: Trace the forged ledger's public transaction trail through the merchant district

resolutionOptions.label: Prove the Public Chain Was Forged
resolutionOptions.description: Show where authentic patrol facts were joined to a transaction that never occurred. This clears the default accusation without exposing a live broker channel.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: The public chain breaks at the payment record: real Watch facts surround a sale that never happened. The accusation no longer survives ordinary verification.

quest_m15_follow_hidden_chain.title: Follow the Hidden Chain
quest_m15_follow_hidden_chain.description: Silas risks a live broker mark because old restraint still carries weight. Follow the hidden chain through the merchant district without converting the access itself into another burned source.

objectives.description: Follow Silas's live broker mark through the merchant district

resolutionOptions.label: Verify the Hidden Chain Without Burning It
resolutionOptions.description: Confirm which broker constructed the forgery while preserving the live route Silas chose to risk.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: The hidden route identifies the broker who assembled the forgery. You return with verification rather than a list of burned names, turning the old callback into new operational evidence.

quest_elara_chain_1.title: A Scholar's Journey: The First Step
quest_elara_chain_1.description: Scholar Elara wants to test your observation skills. Travel to the Whispering Woods.

objectives.description: Travel to the Whispering Woods

quest_elara_chain_2.title: A Scholar's Journey: A Minor Pest
quest_elara_chain_2.description: A rare book was damaged by an Arcane Rat. Elara needs you to deal with it.

objectives.description: Defeat the Arcane Rat

quest_willow_disarm_traps.title: A Delicate Situation
quest_willow_disarm_traps.description: Elder Willow has found a magically trapped chest. She needs someone to disarm it. A brute-force approach might work, but a careful touch with the right tools would be better.

objectives.description: Disarm the magically trapped chest.

puzzleData.prompt: Enter the sequence of runes: Sun, Moon, Star

outcomes.logMessage: You forced the chest open, triggering a minor curse!

quest_m16_withering_grove.title: The Withering Grove
quest_m16_withering_grove.description: A stand of old growth in the Whispering Woods is failing. The visible roots are blackened enough to justify cutting them away, but the pattern may be slower and deeper than the damage on the surface.

objectives.description: Inspect the failing grove in the Whispering Woods

resolutionOptions.label: Remove the Corrupted Roots
resolutionOptions.description: Cut away the visibly failing roots before the rot can spread. The grove survives, but part of the old growth is sacrificed.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You remove the corrupted root mass. The grove stabilizes around the loss: a valid intervention, but an irreversible one.

resolutionOptions.label: Restore the Underlying Flow
resolutionOptions.description: Use Willow's slow-pattern method to trace the visible rot back to the Essence-flow imbalance beneath it, then rebalance the flow instead of cutting the symptom away.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: The blackened roots stop advancing once the deeper flow is corrected. What looked like rot was a symptom; the grove survives without the sacrifice the surface evidence suggested.

quest_m16_impossible_inventory.title: The Impossible Inventory
quest_m16_impossible_inventory.description: Two merchant-district provenance records are each plausible in isolation, yet together they imply the same recovered object occupied two places at once. Decide whether to preserve the most likely linear account or reopen the model around the contradiction.

objectives.description: Compare the archive inventory against the merchant-district provenance trail

resolutionOptions.label: Accept the Most Plausible Inventory
resolutionOptions.description: Keep the contradiction on file but retain the linear account that best fits the majority of the evidence.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You preserve the most plausible inventory model and flag the contradiction for later review. The investigation closes conservatively rather than pretending certainty.

resolutionOptions.label: Reopen the Model Around the Contradiction
resolutionOptions.description: Apply Scholarly Insight: two individually plausible records cannot both be true, so revise the explanatory model instead of defending the first coherent chronology.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You stop treating the contradiction as noise and rebuild the provenance model around it. The apparently coherent inventory resolves into two conflated objects rather than one impossible history.

quest_m17_telluric_echo.title: The Echo Beneath the Grove
quest_m17_telluric_echo.description: A Telluric Echo Fragment has condensed near the recovering grove. Destroy the hostile manifestation. Willow's teaching may reveal how its repeating Essence feedback sustains it, but conventional force remains a valid answer.

objectives.description: Defeat the Telluric Echo Fragment

quest_gc06_lattice_under_strain.title: Lattice Under Strain
quest_gc06_lattice_under_strain.description: The Telluric Echo is stressing the Merchant District as a connected system. Stabilize the local lattice without pretending that one local intervention is the final countermeasure.

objectives.description: Inspect the stressed Merchant District lattice in person

resolutionOptions.label: Contain Surface Failures
resolutionOptions.description: Use ordinary local response capacity to isolate the failures that are currently visible. This buys stability without requiring an optional relationship-derived capability.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You contain the visible failures and stop the local cascade. The district stabilizes enough to act, but the repeating source remains unresolved.

resolutionOptions.label: Reroute the Lattice Load
resolutionOptions.description: Combine Willow's slow-system cognition with Gronk's constraint-first judgment to move pressure away from the lattice paths that are actually failing.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You stop treating each visible break as an isolated repair and reroute the load around the failing lattice pattern.

resolutionOptions.label: Phase Against the Echo
resolutionOptions.description: Combine Scholarly Insight with Adversarial Calibration: model the contradiction as an opponent and phase the local response against the Echo's repeating structure.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You treat the Echo's repetition as a model that can be challenged and phase the local response against the predicted next stress.

quest_gc07_counterphase_principle.title: The Counterphase Principle
quest_gc07_counterphase_principle.description: Return to the Chrono-Crypt with Lyra and derive a reusable inverse to the Telluric Echo's repeating harmonic structure. The crypt records failures; the decision is how to read them.

objectives.description: Reach the Chrono-Crypt harmonic failure chamber

resolutionOptions.label: Manual Harmonic Triangulation
resolutionOptions.description: Compare the preserved failures directly and triangulate the stable inverse pattern with Lyra. Slower and less elegant, but fully legal without optional capabilities.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You and Lyra manually compare the crypt's preserved failures until the inverse pattern becomes stable enough to carry forward.

resolutionOptions.label: Structural Counterphase
resolutionOptions.description: Foreground Structural Steward: combine Willow's slow-system cognition with Constraint Sense to derive the inverse from the crypt's load-bearing pattern.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You trace the failure through the structures that actually carry it and derive a counterphase from the load-bearing pattern rather than the visible symptoms.

resolutionOptions.label: Adversarial Countermodel
resolutionOptions.description: Foreground Countermodeler: combine Scholarly Insight with Adversarial Calibration to treat the crypt's failures as an opponent model and derive the stable inverse.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You model the Echo's preserved failure sequence as an adversary, predict the next phase, and solve for the counterphase that makes that prediction fail.

quest_gc08_distributed_preparation.title: Distributed Network Preparation
quest_gc08_distributed_preparation.description: Prepare the Merchant District with verified counterphase procedures that can be understood and repeated without depending on a specialized build.

objectives.description: Verify distributed counterphase preparation across the Merchant District

resolutionOptions.label: Prepare the Distributed Baseline
resolutionOptions.description: Use ordinary verified procedures to prepare a broad response without relying on optional permanent Traits.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You verify a broad distributed preparation pattern that the network can execute without specialized capability dependencies.

quest_gc08_structural_preparation.title: Prepare the Load Paths
quest_gc08_structural_preparation.description: Use Gronk's network briefing to harden the actual load-bearing paths that will carry counterphase response through the local network.

objectives.description: Prepare the City Center load paths for counterphase routing

resolutionOptions.label: Prepare Structural Load Paths
resolutionOptions.description: Keep Structural Steward foregrounded while translating the counterphase into the network's actual load-bearing paths.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You harden the network's load-bearing response paths instead of distributing preparation evenly.

quest_gc08_diagnostic_preparation.title: Prepare the Diagnostic Mesh
quest_gc08_diagnostic_preparation.description: Seed counterphase diagnostics at the City Gate so the network can detect contradiction in the Echo's next phase rather than treating every disturbance identically.

objectives.description: Establish counterphase diagnostics at the City Gate

resolutionOptions.label: Prepare the Diagnostic Mesh
resolutionOptions.description: Keep Countermodeler foregrounded while seeding diagnostics where the Echo's model is most likely to contradict itself.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You prepare a diagnostic mesh that treats the network as an adversarial sensor rather than a uniform shield.

quest_gc09_distributed_counterphase.title: Prepare the Distributed Counterphase
quest_gc09_distributed_counterphase.description: Turn the distributed network posture into a finale-capable deployment using broad verified procedures rather than optional specialization.

objectives.description: Verify distributed counterphase deployment in the Merchant District

resolutionOptions.label: Prepare Distributed Counterphase
resolutionOptions.description: Use the broad verified network as the finale preparation baseline. No optional permanent Trait pair is required.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You convert the distributed posture into a concrete counterphase deployment that remains legal without optional specialization.

quest_gc09_structural_counterphase.title: Prepare the Structural Counterphase
quest_gc09_structural_counterphase.description: Prepare the load-bearing paths that will carry the counterphase through the finale.

objectives.description: Finalize load-path deployment from the City Center

resolutionOptions.label: Prepare Structural Counterphase
resolutionOptions.description: Use Willow's Wisdom and Constraint Sense to align the finale plan with the network structures that actually carry the response.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You finalize a counterphase deployment around the network's actual load-bearing paths.

quest_gc09_diagnostic_counterphase.title: Prepare the Diagnostic Counterphase
quest_gc09_diagnostic_counterphase.description: Return to the Chrono-Crypt and turn the diagnostic network posture into a prediction-first finale plan.

objectives.description: Calibrate the diagnostic finale model in the Chrono-Crypt

resolutionOptions.label: Prepare Diagnostic Counterphase
resolutionOptions.description: Use Scholarly Insight and Adversarial Calibration to build the finale plan around predicted contradiction in the Echo's next phase.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You calibrate a finale plan that treats the network as an adversarial diagnostic instrument.

quest_gc09_fortified_counterphase.title: Prepare the Fortified Counterphase
quest_gc09_fortified_counterphase.description: Coordinate the Watch-supported network posture into a bounded finale deployment without turning institutional support into a personal Relationship score.

objectives.description: Finalize fortified counterphase logistics at the City Gate

resolutionOptions.label: Prepare Fortified Counterphase
resolutionOptions.description: Coordinate the already-authorized Watch logistics with the counterphase network. No optional Trait pair is mandatory.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You finalize the Watch-supported counterphase deployment while keeping institutional support distinct from personal Relationship.

quest_gc10_telluric_echo_distributed.title: Telluric Echo — Distributed Dissipation
quest_gc10_telluric_echo_distributed.description: Carry the distributed counterphase into the Whispering Woods and dissipate the Echo across the broad verified network.

objectives.description: Enter the Whispering Woods and confront the Telluric Echo with the committed counterphase plan

resolutionOptions.label: Dissipate Through the Distributed Network
resolutionOptions.description: Use the broad verified preparation as the counterphase carrier. This remains legal without any optional two-Trait specialization.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: The prepared network catches the counterphase across many verified response points and dissipates the Echo without requiring a single golden capability.

quest_gc10_telluric_echo_structural.title: Telluric Echo — Structural Redirection
quest_gc10_telluric_echo_structural.description: Carry the structural counterphase into the Whispering Woods and redirect the Echo through the load-bearing paths prepared to hold it.

objectives.description: Enter the Whispering Woods and confront the Telluric Echo with the committed counterphase plan

resolutionOptions.label: Redirect Through the Load-Bearing Paths
resolutionOptions.description: Use Willow's Wisdom and Constraint Sense to route the counterphase through the structures that can actually carry it.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: You redirect the Echo through the load-bearing network paths, letting the counterphase travel where the system can actually sustain it.

quest_gc10_telluric_echo_diagnostic.title: Telluric Echo — Diagnostic Disruption
quest_gc10_telluric_echo_diagnostic.description: Carry the diagnostic counterphase into the Whispering Woods and break the Echo by forcing its predicted phase into contradiction.

objectives.description: Enter the Whispering Woods and confront the Telluric Echo with the committed counterphase plan

resolutionOptions.label: Disrupt the Predicted Phase
resolutionOptions.description: Use Scholarly Insight and Adversarial Calibration to predict the Echo's next move and make that prediction fail.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: The network catches the contradiction in the Echo's next phase and disrupts the repeating structure before it can reassert itself.

quest_gc10_telluric_echo_fortified.title: Telluric Echo — Fortified Containment
quest_gc10_telluric_echo_fortified.description: Carry the Watch-supported counterphase into the Whispering Woods and hold the Echo inside the bounded response network.

objectives.description: Enter the Whispering Woods and confront the Telluric Echo with the committed counterphase plan

resolutionOptions.label: Contain Through the Fortified Network
resolutionOptions.description: Use verified counterphase procedures backed by legally available Watch logistics. No optional two-Trait pair is mandatory.
resolutionOptions.logMessage: The Watch-supported network holds the counterphase long enough to contain the Echo without collapsing institutional authority into personal loyalty.
